name: managing-sepsis-bundles
description: Tracks and abstracts sepsis bundle compliance for one encounter against CMS SEP-1 (Severe Sepsis and Septic Shock Management Bundle) and, on request, the Surviving Sepsis Campaign hour-1 bundle and SSC 2026 guidelines, keeping each framework separate. Builds a timestamp ledger from the MAR, labs, flowsheets and provider notes; computes time zero (severe sepsis presentation time and septic shock presentation time) instead of copying sepsis alert or triage times; scores initial and repeat lactate, blood cultures before antibiotics, antibiotic timing, 30 mL/kg crystalloid for hypotension or lactate of 4 or more, vasopressors for persistent hypotension, and reassessment documentation; screens SEP-1 exclusions by manual version and discharge date; separates SIRS-based SEP-1 criteria from Sepsis-3, SOFA and qSOFA. Use for SEP-1 abstraction, sepsis core measure review, sepsis bundle audit, time zero disputes, or sepsis documentation gaps. Drafts for clinician and quality-abstractor review; no patient orders.
